title: [dynamo][aot_compile] Check compatibility before unpickling artifacts
body:
Stack from [ghstack](https://github.com/ezyang/ghstack/tree/0.15.0) (oldest at bottom):
* __->__ #198061

Ready for review. Final design can get a word from @bobrenjc93.

> AI-generated draft (Codex-assisted implementation and text):
>
> Fixes #196521.
>
> AOTCompiledFunction.deserialize previously decoded the compiled payload without first checking its serialization format, so reducer changes could fail with a bare pickle error. Prefix each artifact with a magic/version marker, validate it before constructing AOTCompileUnpickler, and preflight every child marker in AOTCompiledModel before decoding any child payload.
>
> Legacy and unknown artifact formats now fail deterministically with guidance to recompile. SystemInfo and device_type remain in the existing payload, so environment compatibility is checked after current-format payload decoding. External references, guard scopes, reconstructed globals, and backend restoration remain unchanged.
>
> Test Plan:
>
> ```bash
> PYTHONPATH=../torch_worktree_bootstrap PYTORCH_SOURCE_OVERRIDE="$PWD" python test/dynamo/test_aot_compile.py -k aot_compile_basic_model
> PYTHONPATH=../torch_worktree_bootstrap PYTORCH_SOURCE_OVERRIDE="$PWD" python test/dynamo/test_aot_compile.py -k compatibility_checked_after_compiled_payload
> PYTHONPATH=../torch_worktree_bootstrap PYTORCH_SOURCE_OVERRIDE="$PWD" python test/dynamo/test_aot_compile.py -k rejects_unsupported_aot_compile_format
> PYTHONPATH=../torch_worktree_bootstrap PYTORCH_SOURCE_OVERRIDE="$PWD" python test/dynamo/test_aot_compile.py -k model_preflights_all_aot_compile_formats
> PYTHONPATH=../torch_worktree_bootstrap PYTORCH_SOURCE_OVERRIDE="$PWD" python test/dynamo/test_aot_compile.py -k test_aot_compile_basic_fn
> lintrunner -a
> ```
>
